Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with CC prediction and player history, nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: Hotfix: Smart Action works in Wolves' Den duels again without depending on the unreliable hidden duel slot. Guard repeat protection now starts when Guard is visibly active, so network/UI delay cannot shorten its full one-second window. Existing target and protection checks stay intact. Automated checks are separate from live in-game confirmation.
